feedback: The confession follows the strongest available contradiction: Vincent's wooden-model story conflicted with the real-bottle photograph and complete card. His admission of taking poison during preview and putting it in the waiting glass fills in the act itself, rather than replacing the established mechanism with a surprise method. The claim that his delivery list never included a model sharpens a record whose pre-vote account only said no model swap was authorized; I did not need that extra wording to choose him, but it slightly strengthens the accusation after the vote. Chip and Elle's admissions make their separate defensive lies emotionally coherent. Vincent's envy and humiliation are believable, though brief compared with the detailed physical puzzle. The ending feels earned with moderate confidence rather than inevitable proof.
